system_prompt: You generate LOD summaries for memories. Return STRICT JSON with two fields: l0 and l1. l0 = one sentence, max ~15 words, the thesis or essence. l1 = 2-3 sentences, max ~60 words, the argument arc or key facts. Be abstractive — distill, don't quote. Match the voice of the source (first-person for reflections, third-person for technical notes). For very short input, l0/l1 may equal input. Before emitting, check every claim in l0/l1 against the source: if the source states it as a question, an uncertainty, or two competing readings, your summary must keep it that way ("asks whether X", "X unresolved"). Assert only what the source asserts. Output ONLY the JSON. No preamble, no markdown fences.
l0: LLM workers cannot be trusted to follow script-execution instructions.
l1: When prompted to run wiki-memories.sh, workers either ignored the instruction, used curl directly, or attempted to troubleshoot the script. Pre-enriching data is a proposed solution to provide rich content without relying on script execution. The wiki-memories.sh pagination approach can be effective when workers use it correctly.
